name: SenseNova-SI-1.4-InternVL3-8B
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from OpenGVLab/InternVL3-8B (config.json max_position_embeddings 32768). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. A finetune of OpenGVLab/InternVL3-8B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 7.944 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; every row below is card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-03-24, last modified 2026-05-12. CAVEAT: this is the fourth in a numbered SenseNova-SI series and the released 1.3 sibling scores higher on three of the eight spatial columns (VSI 68.6 vs 66.6, MMSI 42.5 vs 40.1, ViewSpatial 61.3 vs 55.7), so the 1.4 checkpoint is not a monotone improvement over its own predecessor — only over the InternVL3-8B base. Both depth rows and RefCOCO come from a second table evaluated on an internally constructed test set, not a public leaderboard. The card prints no shot count or decoding configuration. The 89.21-vs-89.01 RefCOCO row is a 0.20 margin and is the weakest evidence in the record; the card itself says CountBench went the other way (78.64 vs 81.31), which is why CountBench is not recorded.
